description: This file defines the Env class responsible for loading and providing environment variables in a Flutter application. It includes methods for loading variables from a .env file, handling defaults, and exposing static getters for URLs and mock mode status.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A class providing static methods and getters to load and access environment variables related to API URLs and mock mode configuration.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the .env file, with default fallbacks if loading fails.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Getter returning the API base URL, falling back to default if not set.

methods.name: realtimeUrl
methods.description: Getter returning the WebSocket URL for real-time communication, with default fallback.

methods.name: mockMode
methods.description: Getter returning boolean indicating if mock mode is enabled, based on environment variable.
